detail: The minimal CLI vocabulary (d957df5) moved every internal command under one `internal` multiplex and re-pointed the Rust tests and docs, but missed three shell harnesses that still spelled it `reproit __atspi` / `reproit __tui`. Clap exited 2 before the runner started, so three required gates (linux-atspi-gtk, linux-atspi-toolkits, tui-pty) were red for 17 commits: every failing assertion was of the form 'this marker is PRESENT' and the four that passed were of the form 'this bad marker is ABSENT', which a process that never ran satisfies for free. The defect lives in CI harness wiring, so no runtime guard can hold it; the bounded regression test scans every harness for an internal command not preceded by `internal`, failing on the parent (it cites all five sites) and passing on the fix.
